title: 5. Her supplications seeking mediation of the names of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime
categoryChain: Her supplications in glorification of Allah, exaltation and extolling, and seeking mediation through His names; benediction upon His Prophet and his progeny (a.s.)
5. Her supplications seeking mediation of the names of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime
introduction: Her supplications seeking mediation of the names of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime

verses.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَمّٰى نَفْسَهٗ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِيْ بِهٖ تَقْضٖي حَاجَةَ كُلِّ طَالِبٍ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ كُلِّ اِسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ۔
اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِیْمِ الَّذِیْ اَمَرْتَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ اَنْ یَدْعُوْنِیْ بِهٖ۔
اَسْاَلُكَ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِیْ دَعَاكَ بِهٖ خَلِیْلُكَ حِیْنَ اُلْقِیَ فِی النَّارِ۔
